description: Clean a table: trim whitespace in cells, drop fully empty rows, and optionally remove duplicate rows; returns the table in the same format with before/after row counts. Use when preparing messy pasted data. Do NOT use to change format; use convert_table.

data.description: The whole table as text, first row = header. CSV/TSV text (quoted cells allowed), or a JSON array of flat objects, e.g. "name,age\nAsha,30".

dedupe.description: Remove exact duplicate data rows, keeping the first. Default false.

drop_empty_rows.description: Remove rows whose cells are all empty. Default true.

format.description: Format of 'data' and of the returned table: csv, tsv or json. Default csv.

trim.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace in every cell. Default true.

name: clean_table

text.description: The cleaned table as text in the input format.

title: Clean table
